title: Middle-class Milwaukee neighborhoods of his childhood
summary: Herman describes his family as middle-class movers who lived in five to eight places in north and northeast Milwaukee.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: I'd like to go way back just in order to have you describe more about -- in a little more detail about your home town neighborhood, what does it look like, what kind of place did you live in, what kind of values there were in this neighborhood, just more of a picture of Woody Herman in his early childhood. That's kind of the feeling we --
I would call it truly middle-class sections
From the time I was born, I probably lived in -- oh, at least five or six or seven or eight different locations. But always in the north and northeast part of the city of Milwaukee.
